// why: Mode B adapter-overlay injection of the `auth-guarded` attribute — the ONLY mechanism that clears
`http/protected-path-no-auth-evidence` (its io-scan matcher reads `attr_absent: auth-guarded` and never looks at the
handler identifier). Without this the rule had NO working negative control anywhere in the corpus
and fired on its own `good` export, which stood as the benchmark's single standing false positive.
Two targets on purpose, covering both AttributeStore::route_attr resolution shapes: the exact IoKey
and the covering PathScope. The PathScope prefix is `/admin/audit`, NOT `/admin` — a `/admin` scope
would also cover the module's `bad` route and silently delete the positive case.
